stem.en: About 90% of global trade by volume is carried by sea. What does "by volume" tell you?

text.en: Ships earn nine-tenths of all the money in the world.

feedback.en: Volume is an amount of goods, not money earned, so this does not follow.

text.en: Nine in ten workers in the world depend on ships.

feedback.en: The figure is about goods carried, not about workers.

text.en: Nine-tenths of traded goods go by ship.

feedback.en: Yes. By volume means measured by the amount of goods, not by what they are worth.

text.en: Ships cover nine-tenths of the world's ocean routes.

feedback.en: The figure is about goods carried, not about how much of the ocean is used.

explanation.en: Volume means amount. So about nine-tenths of the amount of goods traded across the world moves by sea. That is why harbours and the people who work in them matter so much to a country like India.

hints.en: Is volume about amount or about money?
